meta.title: Catch And Tame lassos data
meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame wiki lists 13 lasso rows with rank, power, range, acquisition, and pros/cons. Fandom shop context confirms lassos are purchasable upgrades for taming rarer animals; the direct Fandom lasso page was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge during this pass.

items.name: Old Lasso
items.cardSummary: Free starter option with enough reach for the first catches, but no power scaling.
items.bestUse: Use only until the first affordable upgrade is available.
items.limitation: No power and short range make stronger animals slow or impractical.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Wooden Rope
items.cardSummary: Small power step from the starter lasso, traded against the lowest listed range.
items.bestUse: Buy only as a cheap bridge if range is not causing misses.
items.limitation: The short reach makes it awkward once animals move farther away.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Steel Lasso
items.cardSummary: Early upgrade that keeps the same low power while giving a more comfortable catch radius.
items.bestUse: Use as the first practical range upgrade for basic farming.
items.limitation: Falls behind when rare animals start needing more power.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Hunter Loop
items.cardSummary: Range-focused early lasso that helps with positioning but does not improve tame power.
items.bestUse: Use when reach matters more than catch strength.
items.limitation: Zero power makes it unreliable for stronger animals.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Shadow Rope
items.cardSummary: Longer reach than earlier shop options, but its power still stays low for the tier.
items.bestUse: Use as a comfort upgrade while saving for a stronger mid-game option.
items.limitation: The low power makes it a weak long-term Epic choice.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Dragon Loop
items.cardSummary: Balanced mid-game lasso with a real power jump and slightly better reach.
items.bestUse: Use for routine mid-game catching before late-biome requirements become demanding.
items.limitation: Not strong enough to be the final answer for tougher late-game catches.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Prism Lasso
items.cardSummary: Large range option for safer targeting, offset by having no listed power.
items.bestUse: Use when reach and learning catch timing matter more than speed.
items.limitation: Zero power can make each tame take longer than stronger lassos.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Spectral Lasso
items.cardSummary: Strong mid-game power pick with less reach than the widest Rainbow option.
items.bestUse: Use when catch strength matters more than maximum distance.
items.limitation: Its range can feel short in wider late-game spaces.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Anchor Lasso
items.availability: Gacha; listed with a higher drop rate than other Rainbow lassos
items.cardSummary: High-power Rainbow lasso with the same mid-range reach as other strength-focused picks.
items.bestUse: Use as a strong upgrade when power is the main bottleneck.
items.limitation: The source notes an occasional swap miss issue.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Sunforge Lasso
items.availability: Shop or Traveling Merchant rotating stock
items.cardSummary: High-end all-rounder with strong power and workable range.
items.bestUse: Use as a reliable late-game bridge when exclusive options are not available.
items.limitation: Merchant stock may rotate, and the source marks it as expensive.
items.imageStatus: local row image from Fandom Shop/Lassos Sunforged Lasso icon

items.name: Trident Lasso
items.availability: Exclusive Shop with Robux or seasonal events
items.cardSummary: Top power with long reach, making it one of the strongest catch-speed options.
items.bestUse: Use for demanding late-game catches when both power and range matter.
items.limitation: Access depends on Robux purchase or event availability.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected

items.name: Night Veil Lasso
items.cardSummary: Top power with more reach than the other high-power exclusive option.
items.bestUse: Use as a coin-purchased endgame lasso when saving enough cash is realistic.
items.limitation: The listed coin price is extremely high.
items.imageStatus: local row image from Fandom Shop/Lassos Nightveil Lasso icon

items.name: Bone Lasso
items.cardSummary: Longest listed range, with less power than the main endgame strength picks.
items.bestUse: Use when maximum reach is more valuable than fastest catch strength.
items.limitation: Its power is lower than the strongest exclusive lassos.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean local lasso icons collected
